newsitem.title: USA: Qwest buys optic fiber line rights of way.
newsitem.headline: Qwest buys optic fiber line rights of way.

text.p: Qwest Communications International Inc said Tuesday it has reached agreement with Norfolk Southern Corp to install fiber optic cable along the railway's rights of way among eight cities in the Southeast.

Qwest said the agreement is the last major right of way acquisition needed to complete the company's 13,000-mile fiber optic cable network. The company now has 91 percent of the needed rights of way, it said, and rights for the remaining nine percent are under negotiations now.
Qwest said it relies on rights of way contracts with railroads because they represent the most secure environment for the company's fiber optic network.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
